method.summary: Scento analysis of its own paid orders placed between October 2025 and September 2026 (Europe/Bucharest time), shipped to customers across Europe. Every figure is a share, a rank or an index computed from perfume decants (0.75, 2, 5, 8 and 30 ml) that customers paid for.
method.counted: Each decant unit a customer paid for counts once, whatever its size. Rankings order perfumes by decant units. Shares are each group’s part of all paid decant units in the window.
excluded: Orders without a captured payment, free PR and press kits, and replacement shipments for lost parcels
Test, synthetic and staff orders, and orders placed by the Scento team
Free items: welcome gifts, perks, rewards and promotional samples
Full bottles, accessories (atomizer cases, eye patches) and pre-built gift sets that are not a single perfume
Automatic shipments of the legacy per-perfume subscription, where the perfume could be assigned rather than chosen
method.rounding: Shares are rounded to the nearest whole percent, or to the nearest half percent below 10%, so rounded shares need not add up to 100. Indices are rounded to whole numbers and computed from unrounded shares.
method.suppression: Any figure that would rest on too few orders to be stable is withheld and shown as null; a ranked perfume must also clear a minimum number of separate orders, and a country’s top 10 is shown only when all ten places clear it.
method.trend: Trend indices compare the second half of the window (April 2026 to September 2026) with the first half (October 2025 to March 2026) = 100. Quarterly indices use the first quarter that clears the order threshold as 100.

definitions.nicheVsDesigner: Niche and designer follow the house classification in Scento’s catalogue, with obvious misfiles corrected (Ralph Lauren, Issey Miyake and Salvatore Ferragamo count as designer). Scento’s own house perfumes sit outside this split.
definitions.genderStyle: Feminine, masculine and unisex follow the label each perfume carries in Scento’s catalogue.
definitions.middleEasternHouses: Houses based in the Gulf states: Amouage (Oman) and Kajal, Kayali and Widian (United Arab Emirates).
definitions.priceTiers: Price tiers use each perfume’s current 8 ml member price at Scento as the measure of how expensive the perfume is; perfumes without a listed 8 ml member price are left out of this split.
definitions.scentoHouse: Scento’s own house perfumes are kept in the data and flagged with isScentoHouse; none of them is held out of any ranking.

topPerfumesByCountry.title: Most-bought perfumes by country
topPerfumesByCountry.basis: Rank by paid decant units shipped to each country; countries shown only where all ten places clear the threshold

nicheVsDesigner.title: Niche versus designer share of decants
nicheVsDesigner.basis: Share of paid decant units, Scento house perfumes excluded

sizeMix.title: Decant size mix
sizeMix.basis: Share of paid decant units by size

genderStyle.title: Gender style of decants
genderStyle.basis: Share of paid decant units by catalogue label

priceTiers.title: Decants by price tier
priceTiers.basis: Share of paid decant units by the perfume’s current 8 ml member price at Scento

topHouses.title: Top houses by share of decants
topHouses.basis: Rank and share of paid decant units

giftSeasonality.title: Gifting seasonality
giftSeasonality.reason: Withheld in this edition: the window holds less than one full year of comparable trading, so a week-of-year index would measure growth rather than gifting. Gift cards launched at the end of September 2026, so no gift-card share is reported.

topFeminine.title: Most-bought feminine perfumes across Europe
topFeminine.basis: Rank by paid decant units among perfumes labelled feminine in Scento’s catalogue

topMasculine.title: Most-bought masculine perfumes across Europe
topMasculine.basis: Rank by paid decant units among perfumes labelled masculine in Scento’s catalogue

topUnisex.title: Most-bought unisex perfumes across Europe
topUnisex.basis: Rank by paid decant units among perfumes labelled unisex in Scento’s catalogue

topByCountryAndGender.title: Most-bought perfumes by country and gender style
topByCountryAndGender.basis: Rank by paid decant units shipped to each country among perfumes with each catalogue gender label; a country and label are shown only where all five places clear the threshold

quarterly.title: Scento Fragrance Index by quarter
quarterly.basis: Each quarter ranks perfumes and houses by paid decant units and reports shares of paid decant units. Rank changes compare with the previous quarter’s top 25; a figure or list that would rest on too few orders is left out. Size shares (2, 5 and 8 ml) are each size’s part of all paid decant units in the quarter.

climbers.title: Biggest climbers
climbers.basis: Places moved between Q2 2026 and Q3 2026 among perfumes ranked in the top 50 of both quarters

fallers.title: Biggest fallers
fallers.basis: Places moved between Q2 2026 and Q3 2026 among perfumes ranked in the top 50 of both quarters
